ops.title: Test sandbox seam: daemonkit ignores $HOME, tests must set DAEMONKIT_HOME too
ops.body:
Since daemonkit v0.20.9 every home-derived durable path resolves through the
passwd database (internal/realhome.Dir) and ignores $HOME, so a test that only
does t.Setenv("HOME", dir) no longer sandboxes daemonkit-backed state — the
launchd plist dir, the stable program root (~/.daemonkit/bin), and the artifact
store all land in the real home. That is how a cc-review test run overwrote
~/.daemonkit/bin/cc-review with a test binary and seeded ~/.cc-review/v1.

daemonkit exposes DAEMONKIT_HOME (realhome.EnvOverride) as the test seam; it is
read by name at every call, never memoized, so t.Setenv works per test.

Rule: never t.Setenv("HOME", dir) alone. Use internal/testhome — testhome.Temp(t)
for a fresh t.TempDir home, testhome.Pin(t, dir) for a caller-owned dir — which
sets HOME and DAEMONKIT_HOME to the same directory. HOME still matters because
non-daemonkit code reads it.

Never export DAEMONKIT_HOME process-wide in CI or shell config: cc-orchestrate
install-binary.sh uses the same variable name with a different meaning.
